title: uva-ursi nummularia
intro: Uva-ursi nummularia, commonly known as bearberry or kinnikinnick, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to northern Europe, Asia, and North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory effects, which can help to treat urinary tract infections and other conditions. The therapeutic actions of uva-ursi nummularia are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off infections, making it a natural remedy for treating symptoms of cystitis and other urinary tract issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include arbutin, which is responsible for its medicinal properties, as well as other compounds such as phenolic acids and flavonoids that contribute to its therapeutic actions.
